decision: A SLizard check-run conclusion=failure (or parsed request_changes / merge_impact=blocking) is merge-blocking only when the same check-run output.summary is not zero-finding. Zero findings on that summary is advisory. Crash/timeout/cancelled with no parseable zero-finding verdict still block. The gate does not fetch PR review bodies.

governingRule.description: Bound-remedy #4387: name the conclusion=failure plus zero-finding policy, or drop the forever-block clause. Land finding-count with or before parse repair. If the verdict lives on the review body, that is an input-architecture change, not a regex swap.

alternativesConsidered.option: Keep blocking on failedConclusion even when the check-run summary parses to zero findings
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Leaves the forever-block clause unsolved on the surface the gate reads. ci-gate already excludes SLizard from the required set, so failedConclusion is the crash signal -- that signal stays for unparseable/empty summaries.

alternativesConsidered.option: Fetch PR reviews and parse <!-- slizard:verdict --> from the review body
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Live capture of check-run 103182122466 has no verdict HTML comment. That comment is on the review body (finding_count: 0 for SHA a8a20f3 while the check-run reports 1 actionable). Fetching reviews is an input-architecture change; this recut stays on output.summary.

alternativesConsidered.option: Repair Decision/Merge-impact parse without a finding-count gate
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Widens the blocked set: a request_changes that currently fails to parse would start blocking zero-finding reviews.

alternativesConsidered.option: Score the check-run summary with detect()
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: detect() is the review-body finding counter. On the captured summary it returns p1_count=0 while Severity counts say P1: 1.

whyWinner: Names the policy on the surface the gate already reads, lands finding-count with parse, and records that the machine-readable verdict is on the review body so this PR does not pretend a regex swap reaches it.
revisitTrigger: If SLizard starts putting <!-- slizard:verdict --> on check-run output.summary, or if a later issue takes the review-body fetch as an input-architecture change.
